info.title: Ramplight Workshop API
info.description: Job cards for checked-in vehicles: inspection findings, recommended work and customer approval. Get a token from auth-service (POST /api/v1/auth/login) and use Authorize.

get.summary: Reminders on or off, how many days before, and the miles a day assumed
Whether the signed-in customer gets service reminders

put.summary: Turn service reminders on or off for the signed-in customer
Change a service interval (ADMIN; send the version read)

delete.summary: Delete a service interval and what was recorded for it (ADMIN)

put.summary: Which product/service parts, labour and fees are booked to, and the deposit account (ADMIN)

get.summary: One invoice with its lines, taxes and payments

put.summary: Edit a draft: reprice lines, enter part costs, add or remove fees and discounts
put.description: Send every line in order; parts and labour from the job card can't be removed. Send the version you read (409 if stale).

delete.summary: Discard a draft (issued invoices are voided instead)

get.summary: One canned job with its usual parts

put.summary: Change a canned job (send the version you read; 409 if stale)
Archive (false) or restore (true) a canned job

get.summary: The shop's service intervals (a starter list the first time)

post.summary: Add a service interval (ADMIN)
Send the customer a reminder now for the vehicle's services due within 60 days
post.description: 409 when the customer has no account or turned reminders off.

post.summary: Public: the customer's stop link; no more review requests from this workshop
post.description: 404 review-link-invalid for an unknown token. Repeats are harmless.

post.summary: Start connecting the organization's QuickBooks company (ADMIN)
post.description: Returns Intuit's sign-in address; the browser goes there and comes back to returnUrl with ?quickbooks=connected, cancelled, expired or failed.

get.summary: List job cards, newest first (customers see their own)
get.description: estimates=true: only quick estimates whose car hasn't come in; false: only cars at the shop. Mechanics only ever see cars at the shop.

post.summary: Open the job card for a checked-in appointment
post.description: Idempotent on appointmentId: 201 when created, 200 with the existing card on a repeat.

get.summary: The job card's invoice (404 when it has none, or a customer's is still a draft)

post.summary: Draft the invoice of a completed job card
post.description: Lines from its parts and labour plus the location's fees, with the location's tax rates. 409 if the job already has an invoice that isn't void.

post.summary: Log work done on an approved recommendation (IN_PROGRESS)
INSPECTED → AWAITING_APPROVAL (or DECLINED when nothing is recommended)
post.description: Also e-mails the customer a link to approve or decline and sign, when they have an e-mail address (see /estimate-link).

post.summary: APPROVED/PARTIALLY_APPROVED → IN_PROGRESS
Recommend work with a parts and labour estimate (OPEN/INSPECTED)
Record several parts and the labour for an approved item at once (IN_PROGRESS)
post.description: For a canned job's usual parts and hours, as ticked by the mechanic. Labour is at the card's rate. All or nothing.

post.summary: Decline one recommendation (customer, or advisor on the customer's behalf)
Approve one recommendation (customer, or advisor on the customer's behalf)
Record a part used for an approved recommendation (IN_PROGRESS)
Record labour hours for an approved recommendation (IN_PROGRESS)
post.description: hourlyRate is optional and defaults to the workshop labour rate.

post.summary: Record an inspection finding (OPEN/INSPECTED; the first moves OPEN → INSPECTED)

get.summary: The approval link e-mailed to the customer: sent, viewed, reminded, signed (204: none)

post.summary: E-mail the customer a link to approve or decline and sign (replaces an earlier link)
post.description: Only while the estimate awaits approval. 400 no-email-address when the customer has none and no 'to' is given; 503 when e-mail is not set up.

post.summary: IN_PROGRESS/DECLINED → COMPLETED; calculates totals and writes the service history
Close a quick estimate the customer won't go ahead with (declined; before the visit)
post.description: Also cancel its ESTIMATE appointment. Repeats are harmless.

post.summary: Void an issued invoice with nothing paid on it; it keeps its number
Ask for a Google review now (paid invoices; needs the location's review link)
post.description: 409 invoice-not-paid, review-already-requested, review-opted-out or no-review-link; 400 no-email-address.

post.summary: Don't send the scheduled review request (409 review-not-scheduled)
Send an issued invoice to QuickBooks, with the payments not sent yet (and its void)
post.description: A QuickBooks error is kept on the invoice and returned in quickbooks.error.

post.summary: Record a payment taken at the counter (negative = refund, managers and admins)
post.description: Send an Idempotency-Key header: the same key twice records the payment once.

post.summary: Issue a draft: it gets the next number, is locked, and the customer is told
E-mail an issued invoice to the customer
post.description: The whole invoice in the e-mail body, with a link to view it online when the customer has an account. to: blank = the customer's address. 503 when e-mail is not set up.

post.summary: The estimate a link names (404 unknown, 410 replaced or expired)
Approve or decline every pending item and sign (409 estimate-decided when already answered)

get.summary: Canned jobs by category and name
get.description: locationId: only those usable there; q: in name, category or description; includeInactive: archived ones too (for the settings page).

post.summary: Add a canned job (managers and admins)

get.summary: A vehicle's completed jobs, newest first
get.description: Customers see the entries for jobs on their own account.

get.summary: Vehicles with a service due within `days` (or overdue), soonest first
get.description: Only vehicles last serviced at the caller's locations; locationId narrows to one.

get.summary: A vehicle's services due within 30 days or 500 miles of `mileage` (at check-in)
Issued invoices still owed, oldest first, with ageing (now, not for a period)
Hours and labour value per mechanic, by the time the hours were logged
Tax on the invoices issued in the period, per category and rate
Car count, sales, ARO, hours, close ratio for the period and the one before; open work now
Payments and refunds received in the period (up to 1000), with totals per method
Parts fitted in the period (up to 1000)
Completed sales per location
Recommendations declined in the period (up to 1000), for follow-up
Completed sales per day in the given time zone
Estimates sent, approved and declined value, close ratio and sales per advisor
Whether QuickBooks is set up on the server, connected and ready to take invoices
The company's active products and services (ADMIN)
Intuit sends the browser back here after connecting (no sign-in)
Accounts payments can be deposited to: bank and other current assets (ADMIN)
A job card with findings, recommendations and estimates
The customer's signature, once they signed the estimate online (404 before)
The job card opened for an appointment
Invoices, newest first
get.description: status: DRAFT, ISSUED, PARTIALLY_PAID, PAID, VOID or UNPAID (issued or partly paid); from/to: issue time (creation time for drafts); q: number, customer or registration. Customers get their own issued invoices.

get.summary: The invoice's Google review request: NONE, SCHEDULED, SENT, SKIPPED (with why) or CANCELLED
Invoices issued and payments received in [from, to), for CSV export
get.description: Voided invoices and drafts are left out. At most 366 days; 400 when the period holds more than 5,000 invoices.

delete.summary: Disconnect QuickBooks (ADMIN); invoices already sent stay in QuickBooks
